blurb.en: Realtime CV step recorder in four HP. A thousand steps, a random generator and a shift input for transposing.

reviews.title: Antimatter Audio Brain Seed — the long thread
Implanting the Brain Seed — the designer's own writeup

pull.q: A step recorder with many extras that packs as much fun and functionality as we could wedge behind a 4hp panel while keeping the interface as intuitive as possible.
pull.src: Antimatter Audio — the designer's own writeup

quotes.t: Brain Freeze = When Frz is high, the Brain Seed 'freezes' in place, holding its current value and producing no new triggers. Brain Freeze is great for breaking up a sequence and producing new rhythms.
Record 1 to 1000 of steps in variable mode. Record the number of steps that you want until you're done and the Brain Seed will play them back.
